lead.question: 为什么同一则笑话在不同国家反应不同？“病态幽默”又以什么为素材？
lead.warmup: 笑话能否逗人发笑，往往不取决于笑话本身，而取决于听笑话的人在哪儿长大。课文告诉我们：幽默感与民族性格有着神秘的联系，同一则笑话可能让英国人大笑，却让俄国人无动于衷。不过某些滑稽情节又具有普遍感染力，比如卓别林的早期电影。近来源自美国的“病态幽默”把暴死、事故当笑料，究竟可笑与否，还得你自己判断。
goals: 掌握 comedy / comic / humour / sense of humour / universal / appeal 等本课核心词汇，弄清 comic 与 comedy 的词性差别。
学会 whether...or not 引导主语从句，以及 in spite of、no matter where 等让步表达。
读懂课文对“病态幽默”的定义与实例，能复述那个摔断腿的男人的故事。
辨析一般过去时与现在完成时，理解 recently 与现在完成时的搭配。
lead.summary: 课文指出：一则笑话是否可笑，很大程度上取决于我们成长的环境，幽默感与民族特征神秘相连。不过某些滑稽情节具有普遍吸引力，卓别林的早期电影便是明证。近来源自美国的“病态幽默”开始流行，喜剧演员把暴死、重大事故等悲剧当素材，不少人觉得它低级庸俗。课文最后讲了一个实例，供读者自行判断。
lead.tips: whether...or not 作主语从句时不能换成 if；no matter where 与 wherever 可互换，后者更书面。易错点是 in spite of 之后不能再加 but。

questions.q: What is the basis of 'sick' humour?
questions.a: Comedians base their jokes on tragic situations like violent death or serious accidents.
questions.aZh: 喜剧演员把笑话建立在诸如暴死、重大事故等悲剧情节之上。
questions.hint: 课文第10句：Comedians base their jokes on tragic situations like violent death or serious accidents.

questions.q: According to the text, what is the sense of humour bound up with?
questions.zh: 根据课文，幽默感与什么相连？
questions.a: It is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.
questions.aZh: 它与民族特征神秘地联系在一起。
questions.hint: 课文第2句：The sense of humour is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.

questions.q: In spite of national differences, what do certain funny situations have?
questions.zh: 尽管民族不同，某些滑稽情节具有什么？
questions.aZh: 它们具有普遍的吸引力。
questions.hint: 课文第6句：In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal.

questions.q: What happened to the man at the end of the party?
questions.zh: 晚会结束时，那个男人发生了什么？
questions.a: He slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg.
questions.aZh: 他踩到一块冰上滑倒了，摔断了左腿。
questions.hint: 课文最后一句：he slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg.

questions.q: Why is the ending of the story both ironic and 'sick'?
questions.zh: 为什么这个结局既讽刺又“病态”？
questions.a: Because the man kept telling everyone how much he hated hospitals, yet he broke his left leg and would have to go back to hospital.
questions.aZh: 因为那人整晚都在说他多么讨厌医院，结果在晚会上摔断了左腿，又不得不回到医院。
questions.hint: 结合课文最后两句体会“病态幽默”：以悲剧收场，出人意料。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们觉得一则笑话是否好笑，很大程度上取决于我们在哪儿长大。
exercises.a: Whether we find a joke funny or not largely depends on where we have been brought up.
exercises.note: whether...or not 引导主语从句

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管民族不同，某些滑稽情节却具有普遍的吸引力。
exercises.a: In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal.
exercises.note: in spite of 让步，后接名词

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：This funny story is based on a ____ (comedy) situation.
exercises.note: comic 是形容词，comedy 是名词

exercises.q: 句型转换：将 No matter where you live, you would find it difficult not to laugh. 改写为 wherever 引导的句子。
exercises.a: Wherever you live, you would find it difficult not to laugh.

exercises.q: 改错：In spite of national differences, but certain funny situations have a universal appeal.
exercises.a: In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal.（删去 but）
exercises.note: in spite of 不与 but 连用

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The sense of humour is mysteriously ____ (bind) up with national characteristics.
exercises.note: be bound up with 与……相连

exercises.q: 汉译英：近来，一种主要源自美国的新型幽默流行了起来。
exercises.a: A new type of humour, which stems largely from the U.S., has recently come into fashion.

quiz.q: 课文说，一种被称为“病态幽默”的新型幽默近来流行，它主要源自：
quiz.note: which stems largely from the U.S.

quiz.q: 根据课文，幽默感与下列哪一项神秘地联系在一起？
课文中提到，无论你住在哪里，你都很难不对以下哪一内容发笑？
quiz.note: have a universal appeal 的例证

quiz.q: “喜剧演员根据悲剧情节编笑话”，课文为此举出的例子是：
医生用什么话安慰了那位住院的病人？
options: He could leave hospital in time for New Year celebrations.
He would receive a big present.
He could go home at once.
His leg would heal within a week.
quiz.note: chances of leaving... for New Year

quiz.q: 故事结尾，那个男人发生了什么？
options: He slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg.
He fell down the hospital stairs.
He broke his right leg again.
He lost his crutches at the party.
quiz.note: 以悲剧收场的“病态幽默”
